styles.name: starter-header-visual.css
styles.content: .wfv-header{max-width:var(--wf-container-max-width,1160px);margin:auto;padding:20px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;font-family:var(--wf-font-body,system-ui)}.wfv-header a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.wfv-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-weight:800;font-size:20px}.wfv-brand img{height:44px;width:auto;max-width:180px;object-fit:contain}.wfv-brand img[src=""]{display:none}.wfv-header nav{display:flex;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}.wfv-header a:focus-visible,.wfv-menu-toggle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:4px}.wfv-menu-toggle{cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;padding:12px;background:transparent;color:inherit;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:4px}.wfv-header[data-variant="center"],.wfv-header[data-variant="below"]{flex-direction:column}.wfv-header[data-variant="below"] .wfv-brand{align-self:flex-start}@media(min-width:701px){.wfv-menu-toggle{display:none}.wfv-menu:not([open])>nav{display:flex}}@media(max-width:700px){.wfv-header{padding:16px;align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.wfv-brand img{max-width:140px}.wfv-menu nav{flex-direction:column;gap:0}.wfv-menu nav a{padding:12px}.wfv-menu-toggle{display:inline-flex}.wfv-header[data-menu-ready="true"] .wfv-menu nav{display:none}.wfv-header[data-menu-open="true"] .wfv-menu nav{display:flex}} .wfv-header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;color:var(--wf-color-text);background:var(--wf-color-surface)}.wfv-header>*{min-width:0}.wfv-menu{justify-self:end}.wfv-actions>.wf-slot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}.wfv-actions:not(:has(.wf-instance)){display:none}.wfv-header[data-variant="center"]{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1fr)}.wfv-header[data-variant="center"] .wfv-brand{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;justify-self:center}.wfv-header[data-variant="center"] .wfv-menu{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;justify-self:start}.wfv-header[data-variant="center"] .wfv-actions{grid-column:3;grid-row:1}.wfv-header[data-variant="below"] .wfv-menu{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:2;justify-self:start}.wfv-header[data-variant="below"] .wfv-actions{grid-column:3;grid-row:1}.wfv-header[data-variant="shop"] .wfv-menu{justify-self:start}.wfv-header .wf-header-action{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font:inherit}.wfv-header .wf-header-action__label{white-space:nowrap}@media(max-width:700px){.wfv-header,.wfv-header[data-variant="center"]{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:12px}.wfv-header .wfv-brand,.wfv-header[data-variant="center"] .wfv-brand{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;justify-self:start}.wfv-header .wfv-actions,.wfv-header[data-variant="center"] .wfv-actions,.wfv-header[data-variant="below"] .wfv-actions{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}.wfv-header .wfv-menu,.wfv-header[data-variant="center"] .wfv-menu,.wfv-header[data-variant="below"] .wfv-menu{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:2;justify-self:stretch}.wfv-brand{flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:16px}.wfv-brand img{max-width:100%;height:36px}.wfv-actions>.wf-slot{gap:8px}.wfv-brand span{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.wfv-header nav a{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.wfv-header .wf-header-action{gap:4px}}
